what: Why this blocks and serves over local HTTP instead of opening the file directly
title: Render and open a bundled tutorial — run_tutorial
text: Every {webr} exercise compiles Observable JS (OJS), Quarto's runtime loads via ES modules – browsers refuse load ES modules file:// URL. Opening rendered HTML directly (e.g. utils::browseURL() local path, double-clicking file) hits shows "OJS runtime" error, even though plain question()/student_info() widgets (OJS-based) work fine file://. earlier version function used quarto::quarto_preview() render serve tutorial via background daemon process, theory keep running run_tutorial() returned. practice daemon reliably stay alive (confirmed: exit within seconds, even calling R session still running pumping event loop), silently leaving back file:// URL server behind . function now renders one-shot quarto::quarto_render() call package's pkgdown publishing script uses, serves result httpuv::runStaticServer() – -process server separate daemon lose track . trade-blocks caller serving, matching original 'learnr' package's run_tutorial() (built blocking Shiny app) behaved – stop server get prompt back.
